Lotos Netsuit.name: Lotos Netsuit
Lotos Netsuit.description:
Comes with a standard @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.AUMkHYqfODTjgtMD]{Excellent Quality Cyberdeck}.

This Netsuit adds an extra cyberdeck hardware slot that's installed directly into the suit which is uninstalled if the suit is removed.

Montage Variable Clothing.name: Montage Variable Clothing
Montage Variable Clothing.description:
Light Armorjack that can swap between pre-programmed patterns and styles via a connected @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.pDQRjH8q63YyoWSp]{App}

Comes with your choice of 3 pre-programmed patterns or colors selected from either @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.Rs94jDJRrbHVpvIh]{Gang Colors} or @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.7fXDqCH4Z3ZLo5kL]{Generic Chic} styles.

Requires an action to swap styles via connected agent.

Shock Armor.name: Shock Armor
Shock Armor.description: Kevlar armor designed for prison use. While Grappled, you may use an action on your turn shock your attacker forcing them to roll [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs}. On a failure the grapple ends immediately.
